It is a set of concentric enclosures, subjected to different pressures whose magnitude has a lower value from the internal enclosure to the external for deposits subjected to traction as it is the case of bottles of storage of pressurized fluids, while it has a higher value from the internal enclosure to the external enclosure for deposits subject to compression, as is the case of an underwater vehicle subjected to the compression pressure of the medium. title_en: OCEAN - AIR VEHICLE
abstract_en: A vehicle having a wing, a forward propeller configured for forward flight, and an aft propeller configured for submerged travel in a rearward direction. The vehicle center of mass is aft of its floating center of buoyancy, and center of mass and the floating center of buoyancy lie between the first and second propellers. The vehicle has a natural floating orientation in which the vehicle, while floating, has its first propeller located in the air and positioned for initiating airborne flight in a forward direction, and in which the vehicle has its second propeller located in the liquid and positioned for initiating submerged travel in a rearward direction.

title_en: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR PERIODICALLY CHARGING OCEAN VESSEL OR OTHER SYSTEM USING THERMAL ENERGY CONVERSION
abstract_en: An apparatus includes multiple tanks (406a-406b, 506a-506b, 908, 912, 914) each configured to receive and store a liquid refrigerant (410, 510, 1010) under pressure. The apparatus also includes one or more insulated water jackets (408a-408b, 508a-508b, 910) each configured to receive and retain water around at least part of an associated one of the tanks. The apparatus further includes at least one generator (412, 512a-512b, 1012) configured to receive a flow of the liquid refrigerant and to generate electrical power based on the flow of the liquid refrigerant. The apparatus also includes one or more first valves (522-528, 916-918, 1014, 1020) configured to control the flow of the liquid refrigerant between the tanks and through the at least one generator. In addition, the apparatus includes one or more second valves (530-536, 530a-536a, 530b-536b, 920) configured to control a flow of the water into and out of the one or more insulated water jackets.
titles: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR PERIODICALLY CHARGING OCEAN VESSEL OR OTHER SYSTEM USING THERMAL ENERGY CONVERSION || Apparatus and method for periodically charging ocean vessel or other system using thermal energy conversion

title_en: Turbulent flow resistance controlling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a turbulent flow resistance controlling device. The turbulent flow resistance controlling device comprises a bracket, a linear driving assembly and a thin film assembly, wherein a connecting rod mechanism and a guiding groove are arranged on the bracket, the connecting rod mechanism comprises an output end and an input end, the linear driving assembly is arranged in the guiding groove and is connected with the input end of the connecting rod mechanism, the thin film assembly is connected with the output end and can move in a shrinking mode, so that the thin film assembly has an unfolding state and a folding state; and the liner driving assembly can drive the connecting rod mechanism to move so that the connecting rod mechanism can drive the thin film assembly to move, and the thin film assembly switches between the unfolding state and the folding state. According to the turbulent flow resistance controlling device, a fan face is formed by unfolding the thin film assembly to provide the anti-jamming ability for an aircraft during impact of a flow body. According to the turbulent flow resistance controlling device, folding and unfolding movement is achieved by utilizing the linear driving assembly, and the linear driving assembly is rapid in response.

title_en: SUBMARINE AND METHOD FOR OPERATING A BATTERY-FED ELECTRIC DRIVE SYSTEM OF A SUBMARINE
abstract_en: Submarines have a propulsion network (10) for supplying an electric drive. A plurality of parallel battery strings (11, 12) is associated with the propulsion network (10) for continuous energy supply. The parallel connection of battery strings (11, 12) is problematic, because equalizing currents can flow between the battery strings (11, 12). The avoidance of equalizing currents by means of DC-DC converters (13, 14) can lead to overcharging and deep discharging of the individual strings (11, 12). The invention relates to a submarine and to a method for operating a drive system of a submarine, wherein the states of charge (SOC) of at least two battery strings (11, 12) of a propulsion network (10) are synchronized in that the respective states of charge of the battery strings (11, 12) are measured by respective battery management systems (BMSs) (19) and respective string voltages of the battery strings (11, 12) are set by respective DC-DC converters (13, 14) in accordance with the respective measured states of charge.
titles: SUBMARINE AND METHOD FOR OPERATING A BATTERY-FED ELECTRIC DRIVE SYSTEM OF A SUBMARINE || Unterseeboot und Verfahren zum Betreiben eines Antriebssystems eines Unterseebootes || Procedimiento para hacer funcionar un sistema de accionamiento eléctrico alimentado por baterías de un submarino || Submarine and method for operating a drive system of a submarine

title_en: SUBMARINE FUEL SUPPLYING SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for supplying fuel to a submarine and a method for supplying fuel to a submarine using the same, and more specifically, to a system for supplying fuel to a submarine and a method for supplying fuel to a submarine using the same, which allows a mixed fluid (seawater + fuel) discharged from an oil-water separator positioned in a submarine to pass through a re-separation tank before being transferred to a waste fuel tank to extract fuel once more, thereby preventing waste of fuel and environmental pollution. The system for supplying fuel to a submarine comprises: an oil-water separator installed between an engine of a submarine and a fuel tank for supplying fuel to the engine; a re-separation tank storing a mixed fluid separated from the oil-water separator and the engine; and a waste fuel oil tank storing seawater separated from the re-separation tank.
titles: SUBMARINE FUEL SUPPLYING SYSTEM AND METHOD

title_en: SYSTEM FOR CLEANING SUBMARINE ANCHORS
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an anchor cleaning system for a submarine, which sprays seawater toward an anchor stored in a submarine, thereby cleaning the anchor so as to prevent foreign substances such as soil or mud smeared on the anchor from being fixed to the anchor so that a clean state of the anchor is always maintained. The anchor cleaning system for a submarine includes a seawater inflow door, a seawater moving pipe and a seawater spraying nozzle.

title_en: CRYOGENIC OXYGEN STORAGE AND DELIVERY SYSTEM FOR ANAEROBIC POWER PLANT WITH ELECTROCHEMICAL GENERATORS
abstract_en: FIELD: oxygen storage and delivery systems.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to systems for storage and delivery of oxygen on underwater vehicles and submarines with air-independent power plants. The cryogenic system is equipped with an oxygen supply loop to the fuel processor as part of a cryostat, which is connected by liquid and gas to the tank by cryogenic pipelines and in which a working and reserve submersible pumps are installed, a tubular heat exchanger fixed on the inner surface of an additional housing, an oxygen heater, a receiver and a warm the oxygen supply line to the fuel processor. The tubular heat exchanger is connected to the outlet of the pumps at one end of the cryogenic pipeline, and to the oxygen heater at the other end of the cryogenic pipeline. After the pressurization evaporator, an oxygen heater is installed, connected to the receiver for supplying oxygen to the electrochemical generator. The cryogenic pipeline for supplying liquid oxygen to the tank is connected directly to the tubular coil. The container with an additional outer casing is installed in a vacuum compartment made of two sealed partitions and an outer casing of the underwater vehicle.EFFECT: invention allows providing a stable oxygen supply and increasing the period of drainless oxygen storage.1 cl, 1 dwg
titles: CRYOGENIC OXYGEN STORAGE AND DELIVERY SYSTEM FOR ANAEROBIC POWER PLANT WITH ELECTROCHEMICAL GENERATORS

title_en: Forward deployed sensor system
abstract_en: Generally, the present disclosure relates to a forward deployed sensor system or, in a specific embodiment, a forward deployed radar (FDR) system. The forward deployed sensor system includes a radar system and may also include other types of sensors such as optical sensors, acoustic sensors including sonar, and electromagnetic sensors. Further, the forward deployed sensor system may also include a communication system such as a full spectrum receiver/transmitter, a ship to ship relay transponder, a satellite communication system, and global positioning system (GPS) capability. The forward deployed sensor system is able to detect objects in the air, on the sea, and underwater, and communicate such detection to a ship, submarine, aircraft, satellite, or other remote location. Such systems may be used to augment the protection of shipping lanes by military or security forces to allow for peaceful commerce and utility of the sea by all nations.
titles: Forward deployed sensor system || FORWARD DEPLOYED SENSOR SYSTEM

title_en: Bionic fish for marine ranching environment monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic fishes, and discloses a bionic fish for marine ranch environment monitoring, which comprises a bionic fish device, a main observation camera, a quickly detachable underwater propeller, a mounting column, an unlocking button, a waterproof charging port, a waterproof cover plate, simulated fish side wings, a simulated fish tail and simulated fish fins, the device comprises a bionic fish device, a rapidly-detached underwater propeller is detachably arranged below the bionic fish device, two sets of unlocking buttons are installed on the left side and the right side of the bionic fish device, the upper portion of the bionic fish device is fixedly connected to simulated fish fins, the left side and the right side of the bionic fish device are fixedly connected to simulated fish side wings, and the left side and the right side of the bionic fish device are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the bionic fish device. The rear portion of the bionic fish device is fixedly connected to the bionic fish tail, when the device is used, more rapid disassembly and assembly with the bionic fish device can be conveniently achieved through the arranged rapidly-disassembled underwater propeller, the device can be separated from the bionic fish device for storage, and the device has good use prospects.
titles: Bionic fish for marine ranching environment monitoring

title_en: Comprehensive simulation debugging platform for underwater vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive simulation debugging platform for an underwater vehicle, which relates to the technical field of underwater vehicles and comprises a platform bracket, a platform plate, a first debugging mechanism and a second debugging mechanism, the first debugging mechanism comprises two driving rods horizontally arranged at the top of the platform support, supporting seats are rotationally connected to the surfaces of the right ends of the two driving rods, the bottoms of the two supporting seats are fixedly connected with the top of the platform plate, and two cams are connected to the surfaces of the two driving rods through key grooves correspondingly; slings are arranged on the surfaces of the four cams, the four slings are divided into a front group and a rear group, and the bottom end of each group of slings is fixedly connected with a mounting frame through a hanging ring. According to the scheme, the state of the aircraft body is finally switched, the posture of the aircraft body in water is fully simulated, the aircraft body is debugged on the basis, and the accuracy and reliability of debugged parameters can be effectively ensured.
titles: Comprehensive simulation debugging platform for underwater vehicle

title_en: Underwater vehicle and variable-amplitude bionic propulsion design method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater vehicle and a variable-amplitude bionic propulsion design method, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The underwater vehicle comprises a shell, a bionic tail fin, a first driving mechanism and a second driving mechanism, the shell is provided with a tail, the bionic tail fin is rotationally arranged at the tail through a rotating shaft, the first driving mechanism is arranged in the shell, and the second driving mechanism is arranged in the shell; the first driving mechanism comprises a driving unit, a transmission assembly and a swing arm which are sequentially connected, the swing arm is hinged to the rotating shaft and movably connected with the transmission assembly, an included angle is formed between the swing arm and the rotating shaft, and the driving unit can drive the rotating shaft to rotate back and forth through the transmission assembly and the swing arm; the second driving mechanism is arranged in the shell and is connected with the transmission assembly; the second driving mechanism can drive the transmission assembly to move in the direction close to or away from the rotating shaft so as to adjust the included angle between the swing arm and the transmission assembly. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the technical problem that the adjustability of the underwater vehicle propelled by using the bionic tail fin is poor can be solved.
titles: Underwater vehicle and variable-amplitude bionic propulsion design method

title_en: Photovoltaic underwater vehicle profile parameter optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic underwater vehicle appearance parameter optimization method and system, which are used in the field of underwater vehicle design, and the method comprises the steps: sampling the appearance design parameters of an underwater vehicle, and forming an initial sample library; constructing a parameterized model based on the sample library; simulating the parameterized model through a CFD solver; constructing a target function agent model according to the sample library; the proxy model is called through ISIGHT coupled with MATLAB, and the proxy model is optimized through an NSGA-II algorithm; updating the parameterized model based on the optimization variables to generate a new parameterized model; calling a CFD solver through ISIGHT to perform flow field simulation on the new parameterized model, and outputting a simulation result; and comparing the simulation result with the optimal objective function value of the proxy model, and if the comparison result is within an error range, outputting a corresponding shape design parameter. According to the scheme, the optimal shape design of the underwater vehicle can be guaranteed, and waste of computing resources can be avoided.
titles: Photovoltaic underwater vehicle profile parameter optimization method and system

title_en: Ultrasound apparatus and methods for display of a volume using interlaced data
abstract_en: An ultrasound imaging system that produces a seemingly real-time display by obtaining ultrasound data in an interleaved manner. The system includes a transducer that outputs and receives ultrasonic signals and circuitry that causes the transducer to output the ultrasonic signals in a series of frames in an interleaved manner so as to isonify each of a plurality of portions of a subject matter at different times and forms an image based on the echoes from a plurality of frames.

title_en: Digital Data Encoding and Decoding Method using Sound wave for data communication via Sound wave, and Communication Device using the method
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A digital data encoding and decoding method for transmitting/receiving data through sound wave and the digital data transceiver using the method thereof are provided to perform a short distance communication by using the sound wave being used in music at present on the basis of Frequency Shift Keying method. CONSTITUTION: A mapping table that a sound height combination corresponds to a unit value of digital data is produced. Digital data for transmitting is converted into sound height combination rows corresponding to the mapping table, produced the combination sound wave having the frequency of each sound height and then transmitted. A row of the sound height combination is extracted from the sound wave generated from a transmitting device. The extracted respective sound height combination is converted into digital data constructed by digital data unit values corresponding to the mapping table.

title_en: Housing for accommodating an audio device for underwater use
abstract_en: A housing comprises a rigid container and a lid adapted to fit the rigid container, wherein the rigid container is adapted to accommodate an audio device. A hub with an external recess is formed at an end of the housing. A latch has a buckle and a chuck, wherein the buckle is used for locking the lid with the rigid container, resulting in waterproofing, and the chuck is used for driving the buckle moving and releasing the lid. A control panel is located on the housing for externally controlling the audio device. An audio jack is located in the hub for electric connecting the audio device. An adaptor for sealing and engaging with the hub has a waterproof seal, a plug and a knot on the interior wall of the adaptor.

title_en: ULTRASOUND DIAGNOSIS METHOD AND APPARATUS
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To determine the degree of similarity at a higher precision evenly by stabilizing the frame rate without being lowered.

SOLUTION: An ultrasonic diagnostic apparatus has an ultrasonic wave probe in which a plurality of elements is so arrayed as to transmit ultrasonic waves to a subject while outputting received signals by receiving ultrasonic wave signals reflected from the subject, a means for varying assumed sound velocities preset for the actual sound velocities of the ultrasonic waves transmitted to the subject and a frame position calculation means which determines the degree of similarity of parts between frames utilizing RF data or the speckles of amplitude images based on the different assumed sound velocities of two types or more to calculate the positions of the frames.

title_en: Novel power plant of nuclear submarine
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel power plant of a nuclear submarine. High-power driving motors and corresponding control equipment of a condensation pump and a feed water pump are omitted, thus reducing the overall volume of the novel power plant and being beneficial to equipment arrangement. The quantity of the main equipment needing to radiate heat (or emit heat) when running is reduced compared with the quantity of the main equipment of the existing nuclear submarines. The novel power plant reduces the noise of the power system, has good stealth performance, reduces the energy conversion links, has high energy utilization efficiency, reduces the temperature inside and outside the submarine, reduces the hit probability of the heat-seeking torpedoes by the enemies, is equipped with rearward-firing torpedoes and improves the attack capability and the survivability.

title_en: UNDERWATER ACOUSTIC MULTIPLE-INPUT/MULTIPLE-OUTPUT (MIMO) COMMUNICATION SYSTEMS AND METHODS
abstract_en: Methods and systems for acoustic multiple-input/multiple-output (MIMO) communication in an underwater environment. The method includes: a) receiving signals at multiple receivers representing transmitted signals from multiple transmitters, b) estimating channel responses between the multiple receivers and the multiple transmitters, c) performing an initial demodulation process on the received signals using the estimated channel responses to remove inter-symbol interference (ISI), and d) performing at least one subsequent demodulation process on the received signals. The subsequent demodulation process: i) removes co-channel interference (Col) using the estimated channel responses and demodulated signals from an immediately preceding demodulation process to form interference cancelled signals and ii) removes ISI from the interference cancelled signals. In the initial and subsequent demodulation processes, ISI removal includes a time reversal combining process followed by a single-channel decision feedback equalization (DFE) process.

title_en: Analysis method for radar wave reflected signal
abstract_en: Disclosed is an analysis method for radar wave reflected signal for carrying out calculation to a radar echo wave signal set corresponding to a river to be tested. The analysis method is to manufacture a calculating unit including a digital filter, and carry out a filtering operation to the radar echo wave signal set by the digital filter so as to acquire a filter coefficient set. Then the calculating unit carries out a convolution operation to the filter coefficient set by a default signal set so as to acquire a filter signal set, and carries out energy spectrum transformation to the filter signal set so as to acquire an energy spectrum set corresponding to energy and frequency. Then a peak frequency parameter corresponding to an energy maximum peak value is calculated. Finally, a surface flow velocity parameter is calculated based on the peak frequency parameter for obtaining surface flow velocity of the river to be tested after interference is filtered.

title_en: Audio communication method and audio terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides an audio communication method and an audio terminal. The audio communication method comprises the steps of acquiring status information of other audio terminals by a local terminal; and transmitting an audio signal to other audio terminals which are currently available for audio communication according to the acquired status information. Due to the implementation of the audio communication method, the audio terminal transmits the audio signal to other audio terminals which are currently available for audio communication according to the status information, thus being capable of broadcasting specially for target audio terminals available for communication according to the status information; moreover, the audio communication method capable of broadcasting purposefully can be used for realizing data interaction of multiple audio terminals without modifying hardware of a conventional audio terminal, thus improving the user experience.

title_en: DOPPLER IMAGING SIGNAL TRANSMISSION DEVICE, DOPPLER IMAGING SIGNAL RECEPTION DEVICE, DOPPLER IMAGING SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To expand an application range by improving detection accuracy and a measurement range of Doppler imaging in comparison with prior arts.SOLUTION: A Doppler imaging system generates the same two log-step multicarrier signals as a log-step multicarrier signal which is a multicarrier signal having a plurality of frequencies arranged at an exponential function interval, couples the two log-step multicarrier signals in the front/rear inverted direction around an origin on a time axis, generates log-step multicarrier signal symmetric with respect to the origin, and transmits the signal to a target object as a transmission signal. The Doppler imaging system receives a reflection signal from the target object, and measures and images at least one of a position and a speed of the target object by performing measurement processing of Doppler imaging on the basis of the received reflection signal and the transmitted symmetric log-step multicarrier signal.

title_en: Early assessment method of long-wave induced run-up heights
abstract_en: The present invention provides a new the method, including a computational module related to the temporal wave data, to early forecast the long-waves induced the run-up height and inundation distance on the coastal area. The computational module includes Fourier coefficients matrix of wave data and an energy matrix. In which, Fourier coefficients matrix can be obtained by a temporal wave data using Fast Fourier Transformation (FFT), and the energy matrix can be built beforehand by applying the analytical Green's function (AGF). The advantage of present module is that uses the simple multiplication and summation to replace the complicated numerical integration, and can significantly reduce the estimated time. The present module can provide the early assessment of long-waves (such as tsunami waves) induced the runup height and inundation distance on the coastal region.

title_en: ULTRASONIC DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT
abstract_en: An ultrasound diagnostic apparatus according to a present embodiment includes driving pulse generating circuitries and a transmission control circuitry. The transmission control circuitry turns on a switching element of respective driving pulse generating circuitries of the driving pulse generating circuitries to be grounded, and thereby controls so as to make an output impedance of the respective driving pulse generating circuitries become a low impedance. The transmission control circuitry turns off the switching element of the respective driving pulse generating circuitries, and thereby controls so as to make the output impedance become a high impedance by means of a resistance value of the resistance. The transmission control circuitry controls so as to make the output impedance of the respective driving pulse generating circuitries become a lower impedance during a transmission period in which the ultrasound is transmitted than during a reception period in which a reflected wave of the ultrasound is received.

title_en: ULTRASOUND PROBE WITH LOW FREQUENCY, LOW VOLTAGE DIGITAL MICROBEAMFORMER
abstract_en: An ultrasound probe (106) contains an array transducer (101) and a microbeamformer coupled to elements of the array. The microbeamformer comprises analog ASICs (102) with transmitters and amplifiers coupled to elements of the array (101). The microbeamformer also comprises analog to digital converters which convert received echo signals to digital data, and digital beamforming circuitry located in digital ASICs (103). The digital ASICs (103) are clocked at a lower core frequency than that of which the digital integrated circuit process of the digital ASICs (103) is capable, and the digital ASICs (103) are operated at a lower supply voltage than that for which the digital integrated circuit process is designed, both of which reduce power consumption by the microbeamformer.

title_en: Detecting changes at cell sites and surrounding areas using unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: Systems and method for cell site inspection by a cell site operator using an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and a processing device include creating an initial computer model of a cell site and surrounding geography at a first point in time, wherein the initial computer model represents a known good state of the cell site and the surrounding geography; providing the initial computer model to one or more of the UAV and the processing device; capturing current data of the cell site and the surrounding geography at a second point in time using the UAV; comparing the current data to the initial computer model by the processing device; and identifying variances between the current data and the initial computer model, wherein the variances comprise differences at the cell site and the surrounding geography between the first point in time and the second point in time.

title_en: Communication method and device based on whale call pulse time duration
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater communication. In order to improve stealthiness of the underwater communication, the invention employs the technical scheme of a communication method and device based on whale call pulse time duration. A communication coder selects call pulses of corresponding time duration from a whale call pulse library, codes communication information and then transmits whale call pulses with coding information to a sound source; the sound source transmits the whale call pulses to water; and a communication decoder decodes the communication information according to the time duration of each call pulse and outputs the decoded communication information through a communication signal output device. The method and the device are mainly applied to anunderwater covert communication occasion.

title_en: REAL-TIME WAVE DETECTING DEVICE AND DYNAMIC LOAD MONITORING SYSTEM INCLUDING THE SAME
abstract_en: Disclosed are a real-time wave measurement device, and a dynamic load monitoring system of a ship having the same. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the real-time wave measurement device and the dynamic load monitoring system of a ship having the same comprise: a socket coupled to an outer plate of a hull; a control plug coupled to be rotated to the socket to be rotated around a virtual central shaft (X) penetrating a center unit of the socket; and a sensor mounted in the control plug to control the arrangement direction in accordance with the rotation of the control plug.

title_en: Audio data communication method and headset
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present application provides an audio data communication method and a headset. The method includes: receiving and decoding audio data of two channels from an audio source device.The decoded audio data of one channel is re-encoded and packaged into a predetermined data format and modulated, and is transmitted by ultrasonic wave; Play audio from another channel. By adopting thescheme provided in the embodiment of the present application, the radio frequency radiation can reduce the harm to human health, and at the same time, the radio frequency transmission of the left andright channels can be realized.

title_en: SYSTEM AND METHODS FOR ELASTOGRAPHIC AND VISCOELASTOGRAPHIC IMAGING
abstract_en: A High Definition ViscoElastography (HDVE) inertial driver apparatus of an imaging system and method includes one or more HDVE inertial driver devices. Each HDVE inertial driver device has: (i) a driver interface that enables receiving a driver signal from a controller; (ii) a resonating surface; and (iii) an inertial driver communicatively coupled to the driver interface and mechanically coupled to the resonating surface to independently generate a resonating displacement of the resonating surface. A support member of the HDVE inertial driver apparatus positions the two or more HDVE inertial driver devices into acoustic contact with a body to produce a shear wave field through a volume of tissue within the body or a material within an object.

title_en: Geoid measurement method, geoid measurement apparatus, geoid estimation device, and geoid calculation data collection device
abstract_en: The present invention enables easy measurement of a change in geoid height. This geoid measurement method involves performing an inertial measurement data acquisition step, a contrast data acquisition step, a state variable estimation step, and a geoid calculation step. The inertial measurement data acquisition step is for acquiring, on the basis of outputs of an inertial measurement unit having a triaxial gyro and a triaxial acceleration meter that are to be mounted to a mobile body, data pertaining to velocity, position, and attitude angle as inertia-derived data. The contrast data acquisition step is for acquiring, from a unit other than the inertial measurement unit, velocity-related data as contrast data. The state variable estimation step is for estimating, using the inertia-derived data and the contrast data, a state variable containing a plumb line deviation by applying a Kalman filter in which plumb line deviation is included in the state variable. The geoid calculation step is for determining, on the basis of an estimated plumb line deviation, a change in geoid height at a position determined by said estimation.

title_en: ANALOG BEAMFORMER
abstract_en: An analog beamformer includes: an input circuit configured to receive an input signal to generate a first input signal having the same phase as the input signal and a second input signal having a phase difference corresponding to a first phase with respect to the input signal; a first delay circuit configured to delay the first input signal to output a first delayed signal; a second delay circuit configured to delay the second input signal to output a second delayed signal; and an output circuit configured to output an output signal by summing the first delayed signal and the second delayed signal, wherein a first write signal has the phase difference corresponding to the first phase with respect to a second write signal, and a first read signal has the phase difference corresponding to the first phase with respect to a second read signal.

title_en: High-frequency long-acting pressure type wave tide measuring instrument and wave data processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-frequency long-acting pressure type wave tide measuring instrument and a wave data processing method, the high-frequency long-acting pressure type wave tide measuring instrument comprises a connecting end and a metal shell, the bottom end of the connecting end is fixedly connected with the top end of the metal shell. The invention relates to the technical field of pressure type wave tide instruments. According to the high-frequency long-acting pressure type wave tide measuring instrument and the wave data processing method, waves are sorted by adopting an improved bubbling sorting algorithm; finally, the sorted waves are averaged; wave measurement is based on conversion of an actually measured pressure wave surface into surface waves. In order to obtain various elements of surface waves, a pressure wave spectrum is converted into a surface wave spectrum at a low-frequency side; waves are sorted by adopting an improved bubbling sorting algorithm, a pressure type wave tide instrument uses a high-resolution sensor to measure pressure fluctuation caused by surface waves, software can obtain a relationship between a wave surface and fluctuation pressure according to a linear wave theory, and statistical analysis is carried out on wave data to obtain characteristic parameters such as wave height and wave period.

title_en: OCEAN SURFACE DISPLAY DEVICE AND OCEAN SURFACE MEASURING PROGRAM
abstract_en: To facilitate detection of images and reduce maintenance management in measuring waves in the surface of the ocean.SOLUTION: The present invention relates to an ocean surface measuring device 3 including: an image division unit 31 for dividing a radar image and generating sectional images; an ocean measuring unit 32 for measuring at least one of the length, the direction, the velocity, and the height of waves in each sectional image on the basis of a wave number space analysis or an actual space analysis in each sectional image; and a disturbance detection unit 33 for detecting the presence of a disturbance in at least one of the length, the direction, the velocity, and the height of waves in the ocean surface in an evaluation sea area shown by one sectional image on the basis of at least one of the length, the direction, the velocity, and the height of waves in the ocean surface in the evaluation surface and at least one of the length, the direction, the velocity, and the height of waves in the ocean surface in a surrounding sea area shown by the surrounding sectional image of one sectional image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sea ice growth observation system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polar region observation devices, and discloses a sea ice growth observation system, the sea ice growth observation system comprises a buoy and a sea ice observation subsystem, the sea ice growth observation system is characterized in that the buoy is configured to float above sea ice surface, the outer wall of the buoy is provided with concave grains for icing, the sea ice observation subsystem comprises a plurality of groups of sea ice thickness sensors which are in one-to-one correspondence along the vertical direction; and the plurality of groups of sea ice thickness sensors are arranged at the periphery of the buoy at intervals. Beneficial effects are as follows: the buoy can float on the sea throughout the year; when the temperature isreduced to an icing condition; seawater located in the concave lines can be frozen, meanwhile, the friction force between newly-generated sea ice and the buoy during sea ice freezing is increased, thefreezing strength during sea ice growth is improved, and therefore the influence of waves and ocean currents on buoy freezing can be resisted, the posture stability of the buoy during newly-generatedsea ice growth is improved, and the accuracy of observing the newly-generated sea ice is improved.

title_en: Multi-beam sonar imaging method in heterogeneous environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-beam sonar imaging method in a heterogeneous environment, and aims to overcome the defect that real-time imaging is difficult due to too long consumed time caused by huge calculation amount when a large amount of echo data is processed in the conventional method. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, a sonar receiving array is divided into a plurality of sub-arrays; then, the CPU allocates a memory for a storage space required by the echo data, and reads the echo data received by each sub-array; the read echo data is transmitted into a GPU, the GPU carries out two-dimensional fast Fourier transform on the echo data in the space direction and the distance direction, and then the echo data is subjected to distance pulse compression; and finally, a compression result is transmitted back to the CPU from the GPU, the CPU carries out modulus operation on the result, and real-time imaging of the multi-beam sonar is completed.

title_en: System for supplying liquefied oxygen in underwater
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a submarine liquid oxygen supply system, capable of stably supplying liquid oxygen to a fuel cell, which comprises: a liquid oxygen container in which liquid oxygen is stored; a liquid line; a gas line; an external vaporization line connected to the liquid line; a safety valve connected to the liquid oxygen container; a pressure sensor connected to the safety valve; a watertight pressure sensor; and a manual valve.

title_en: Rapid network distribution method based on sound waves, mobile terminal and equipment to be subjected to network distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid network distribution method based on sound waves, a mobile terminal and equipment to be subjected to network distribution. When the method is applied to a mobile terminal and equipment to be subjected to network distribution, the method comprises the following steps: the mobile terminal sends a specific sound wave signal to the equipment to be subjected to network distribution; starting an AP connection point after the network distribution equipment receives the specific sound wave signal; the mobile terminal is connected to the AP connection point and sends pre-stored router information to the equipment to be subjected to network distribution through the AP connection point after connection; the equipment to be subjected to network distribution is connected to the corresponding router according to the received router information; and the mobile terminal is connected to the corresponding router to complete network distribution operation. Based on a sound wave technology, after a user sends a specific sound wave signal through a mobile terminal, a device to be subjected to network distribution opens a specified AP connection point according to the specific sound wave signal, and the mobile terminal is connected with the AP connection point, then realizes communication with the device to be subjected to network distribution, and sends information of a router to be connected to the device to be subjected to network distribution to complete a network distribution function; the method has the advantage of simplifying the network distribution operation of the user by one-key network distribution.

title_en: Flood level monitoring method and system for power equipment facilities
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a flooding water level monitoring method and system for power facilities, including after receiving a flooding emergency response notification and a heavy rainfall defense alarm, starting facility flooding water level monitoring; and based on the individual area and total area of facilities affected by flooding and water level sensing monitoring information, establishing a neural network measuring an affected range, and outputting the monitoring result of a flooded surface height in a region, thereby achieving all-weather real-time monitoring, and accurately measuring and timely reporting a flooding height.

title_en: Detection of ferromagnetic objects submerged in a body of water
abstract_en: Systems and methods to detect ferromagnetic objects, particularly submerged, non-naturally occurring ferromagnetic objects, account for contributions to the magnetic field arising from topography, such as magnetic refraction at bathymetric slopes. Removing this topography component of noise from detected total magnetic field enhances detection capability of, for example, naval surveillance systems.

title_en: Verification device of gravitational acceleration type wave sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calibration device for a gravitational acceleration type wave sensor, and relates to the technical field of ocean observation equipment and peripheral supporting facilities thereof, and the calibration device comprises an upper computer, a servo electric cylinder, a pulley block, a connecting rope and a mounting bracket. The upper computer is connected with and controls a telescopic rod of the servo electric cylinder to drive a movable pulley of the pulley block to perform telescopic reciprocating motion, and the stroke is amplified through the pulley block to drive the to-be-calibrated wave sensor to perform lifting reciprocating motion; and the upper computer obtains measurement motion data of the to-be-verified wave sensor in the lifting reciprocating motion process, and verifies the to-be-verified wave sensor in combination with the measurement motion data of the to-be-verified wave sensor in the lifting reciprocating motion process. The verification device is simple in structure and low in manufacturing cost; the stroke is amplified through the pulley block, so that the to-be-verified wave sensor can be verified in a small verification site, and the requirement for the verification site is effectively reduced.

title_en: Equally-spaced time delay acoustic beam regulation and control method for ultrasonic plane wave imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses an equal-interval time-delay sound beam regulation and control method for ultrasonic plane wave imaging, which belongs to the field of ultrasonic imaging, and comprises the following steps: firstly, transmitting a plane wave without deflection and receiving an echo signal, then sequentially transmitting a multi-angle plane wave with equal time-delay interval and receiving the echo signal, and finally transmitting the plane wave with the equal time-delay interval and receiving the echo signal; and finally, constructing ultrasonic data emitted each time through beam forming, and carrying out plane wave composite imaging to form a high-quality ultrasonic image. According to the invention, a unique equal-interval delay plane wave emission strategy is adopted, compared with a traditional equal-angle interval plane wave emission strategy, delay errors caused by sampling rate limitation in plane wave emission are eliminated, the ultrasonic plane wave imaging quality is improved, and the method shows superiority especially in high-frequency ultrasonic application. According to the invention, clearer and more accurate imaging results can be obtained in the field of medical imaging, and the application of the ultrasonic technology in clinical diagnosis and treatment is further promoted.

title_en: Flood season embankment project shore-based root stone detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood season embankment project shore-based root stone detection method, which is characterized in that according to embankment project shore-based root stone detection operation conditions and environment requirements, a full-angle intelligent hydraulic mechanical arm is utilized to carry a light-weight low-frequency sonar to complete flood season embankment project shore-based root stone monitoring, so that the flood season embankment project shore-based root stone monitoring efficiency is improved; the cost and risk of bank foundation stone monitoring of the embankment project in the flood season are reduced, the bank foundation stone problem of the embankment project can be found in time, and the embankment safety is improved.

title_en: A FLUID SILENCER FOR A PIPE
abstract_en: Die vorliegende Erfindung betrifft einen Flüssigkeitsschalldämpfer 10, wobei der Flüssigkeitsschalldämpfer 10 ein inneres Flüssigkeitsvolumen 31 für eine durchfließende Flüssigkeit aufweist, wobei der Flüssigkeitsschalldämpfer 10 ein äußeres Gehäuse 32, 33, 34 aufweist, wobei der Flüssigkeitsschalldämpfer 10 ein das innere Flüssigkeitsvolumen 31 umgebendes Dämpfungselement 40 aufweist, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass das Dämpfungselemente 40 Hohlräume 42 zur Anpassung der Dämpfungscharakteristik des Dämpfungselements 40 aufweist.

title_en: Automatic water regimen measuring and reporting system and method integrating flood discharge early warning and dam safety monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data monitoring, and discloses a flood discharge early warning and dam safety monitoring integrated water regimen automatic forecasting system and method, and the method comprises the steps that a cloud data server generates a water regimen forecasting task according to a dam forecasting area and a water regimen forecasting device, and carries out flood discharge early warning and dam safety monitoring according to a water regimen forecasting point sequence in the water regimen forecasting task; the water regimen forecasting equipment of the first water regimen forecasting point collects water regimen data and obtains a rapid water regimen detection feature value according to the water regimen data of the first water regimen forecasting point and the basic water regimen data, the water regimen forecasting equipment obtains the feature difference of the water regimen forecasting point, if the feature difference is within a set feature difference threshold range, the water regimen of the water regimen forecasting point is normal, and if the feature difference is not within a set feature difference threshold range, the water regimen is normal. And continuing to collect the water regimen data of the water regimen forecasting points according to the water regimen forecasting point sequence until the water regimen forecasting task is completed. According to the invention, rapid judgment and detailed analysis of water regimen are combined, and the monitoring efficiency and accuracy are improved.

title_en: Marine multi-source observation data fusion assimilation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ocean multi-source observation data fusion assimilation method and system, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-source ocean observation data; uniformly converting the timestamps and the space grids of the multi-source ocean observation data into a data format of an FVCOM numerical model; constructing a data fusion assimilation model; the data fusion assimilation model comprises an FVCOM physical model and an AC-PKAN neural network; training the data fusion assimilation model, and adjusting the weight parameter of the data fusion assimilation model according to the dynamic observation data currently acquired by the edge device; and fusing and assimilating the multi-source marine observation data by using the data fusion assimilation model to obtain multi-source fusion marine observation data. According to the method, the timestamps and the space grids of the multi-source marine observation data are synchronized, and then the data fusion assimilation model is constructed for fusion assimilation, so that the fusion accuracy of the multi-source marine observation data can be improved.

title_en: Signal synchronization
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a aystem for synchronizing signal transmission between two devices communicating through acoustic signals The first device including an acoustic transmitter transmitting in a chosen time sequence and frequency range and the second including an acoustic receiver. The first device is configured to initialize the communication transmitting an initial signal representing the time sequence, the time sequence being constituted by signals including information packages being separated by time windows varying according to a predetermined rule. The second device includes an analyzing unit being configured to apply a filter on the receiver corresponding to the time sequence within the predetermined time window variation.

title_en: UNDERWATER ACOUSTIC COMMUNICATION SYSTEM AND SYNCHRONIZATION METHOD
abstract_en: This underwater acoustic communication system comprises: a transmission device that stores, in a preamble of each of a plurality of frames, a known sequence different for each frame, and transmits the plurality of frames in a time series using sound waves; a receiver that acquires, for each reception point, the plurality of frames transmitted in a time series; a plurality of preamble detection units that detect, in a time series for each reception point, the preambles containing the different known sequences; a selection unit that selects, for each reception point, a frame with the preamble containing the same known sequence; a reception time determination unit that determines, for each reception point, the time of reception of the selected frame; a reference time determination unit that determines a reference time; a difference determination unit that determines, for each reception point, the difference between the time of reception of the frame determined for each reception point and the determined reference time; and two or more timing synchronization units that offset, for each reception point, the timing of the plurality of acquired frames on the basis of the difference determined for each reception point.

title_en: Surface flow velocity measurement method and device based on multi-scale space-time image fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a surface flow velocity measurement method and device based on multi-scale space-time image fusion. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a river channel video of a target measurement point; processing the river channel video to obtain a multi-scale projection image set; processing the multi-scale projection image set to obtain a multi-scale space-time image; processing the plurality of scale space-time images to obtain initial interpretation flow rates of the plurality of scale space-time images and statistical characteristic parameters of the plurality of scale space-time images; inputting the plurality of statistical characteristic parameters and the plurality of scale space-time images into a measurement point flow velocity adaptive optimization model to obtain flow velocity weights of the plurality of scale space-time images; and obtaining the target surface flow velocity according to the initial interpretation flow velocity of the multi-scale space-time images and the flow velocity weights of the multi-scale space-time images. According to the scheme, the limitation of single projection resolution analysis of a traditional space-time image method can be solved, and the river surface flow velocity measurement accuracy and stability are improved.

title_en: Improved hydrological situation change evaluation method for quantifying influence of water conservancy project
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved hydrological situation change evaluation method for quantifying the influence of a water conservancy project, and the evaluation method can more accurately quantify the hydrological situation change degree of the influence of the water conservancy project through the improvement of a change range method based on an IHA index system. The evaluation method comprises the following steps: collecting long-sequence flow data of hydrological stations closer to the downstream of a water conservancy project before and after the construction of the water conservancy project; calculating IHA evaluation indexes of two periods before and after the construction of the water conservancy project; calculating upper and lower target boundaries of each evaluation index before hydraulic engineering construction; analyzing a natural change rule of the flow, and optimizing upper and lower target boundaries of part of evaluation indexes; providing a discrete-variable weight method, and assigning the weight of each evaluation index according to discrete and variable conditions; and calculating the hydrological situation change degree after the construction of the water conservancy project by using a change range method according to the determined upper and lower target boundaries and weights of the final evaluation indexes.
